options.name: append_to_existing
options.description: Specifies when job is already available and new list of virtual machines needs to be added to existing list. If not specified new list of vms will replace the existing vms available in the Protection job. In case of tag based jobs, if append_to_existing is set to true new list of tags will be added to already available tags. Optional and only valid when (environment=VMware)

options.name: cancel_active
options.description: Specifies if Current Running Backup Job should be canceled.  If False, active jobs will not be stopped and a failure will be raised. Optional and only valid when I(state=stopped)

options.name: cluster
options.description: IP or FQDN for the Cohesity Cluster

options.name: cohesity_admin
options.description: Username with which Ansible will connect to the Cohesity Cluster. Domain Specific credentails can be configured in following formats AD.domain.com/username AD.domain.com/username@tenant LOCAL/username@tenant

options.name: cohesity_password
options.description: Password belonging to the selected Username.  This parameter will not be logged.

options.name: delete_backups
options.description: Specifies if Snapshots generated by the Protection Job should also be deleted when the Job is deleted. Optional and only valid when I(state=absent)

options.name: delete_sources
options.description: Specifies job is already available, if source available in Protection Job needs to be removed. Optional and only valid when (environment=Physical, PhysicalFiles, GenericNas)

options.name: delete_vms
options.description: Applicable only when job is already available List of virtual machines will be removed from the job. Optional and only valid when (environment=VMware)

options.name: description
options.description: Optional Description to assign to the Protection Job

options.name: disable_indexing
options.description: Enabling this will disable indexing while creating/updating the backup jobs.

options.name: environment
options.description: Specifies the environment type (such as VMware or SQL) of the Protection Source this Job is protecting. Supported environment types include 'PhysicalFiles', 'VMware'

options.name: exclude
options.description: Specifies the list of VMs to be exclude. Applicable only when environment is set to VMware.

options.name: exclude_tags
options.description: Specifies the list of VMware tags to be exclude. Applicable only when environment is set to VMware. Yet to be implemented.

options.name: include
options.description: Specifies the list of VMs to be included. Applicable only when environment is set to VMware.

options.name: include_tags
options.description: Specifies the list of VMware tags to be included. List of objects with category name as key and user tags as list should be provided Applicable only when environment is set to VMware.

options.name: indexing
options.description: Specifies the list of allowed and denied indexing prefixes Applicable only when disable_indexing is set to false. allowed_prefix contains list of prefixes to be allowed while indexing. denied_prefix contains list of prefixes to be denied while indexing.

options.name: name
options.description: Name to assign to the Protection Job

options.name: ondemand_run_type
options.description: Specifies the type of OnDemand Backup.

options.name: protection_policy
options.description: Valid policy name or ID for andexisting Protection Policy to be assigned to the job. Required when I(state=present).

options.name: protection_sources
options.description: A list of dictionaries with endpoints and paths to backup. Required when I(state=present). (valid only for physical sources and file based protection jobs) protection_sources contains list of dicts(endpoint(str), paths(dict)) excludeFilePaths - (List, defaults to empty list [], optional field) - String includeFilePath  - (String, default / for linux machines, required field for windows machines) skipNestedVolumes - True (Boolean, defaults to True)

options.name: start_time
options.description: Specifies the registered start time for the Protection Job.  Format must be 24hr time in either HHMM or HH:MM style. If not configured then the Cluster will automatically select a time.

options.name: state
options.description: Determines the state of the Protection Job

options.name: storage_domain
options.description: Existing Storage Domain to which the Protection Job will be associated. Required when I(state=present).

options.name: time_zone
options.description: Specifies the timezone to use when calculating time for this Protection Job such as the Job start time.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Switch determines if SSL Validation should be enabled.

options.name: view_name
options.description: Specifies the name of view to be protected. Required when environment is set to View.
